'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[2024 Beqaa Valley airstrikes]]
****Fifteen rescue workers are killed during an [[Israel]]i airstrike on the [[Lebanese Civil Defense|Regional Civil Defense Centre]]'s headquarters in [[Baalbek]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0mzkg7rleko (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***The [[Russian Defence Ministry]] claims that [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] have captured the village of [[Voznesenka, Donetsk Oblast|Voznesenka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/russia-claims-it-took-control-of-another-settlement-in-ukraine-s-donetsk-region/3393844 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]], [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***One person is killed and ten others are injured in [[Russia]]n [[airstrike]]s on an apartment building and energy facilities in [[Odesa]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-drone-attack-damages-energy-installations-ukraines-odesa-2024-11-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Israel's role in the Syrian civil war]]
***Sixteen people are killed and 15 others are injured in [[Israel]]i airstrikes against residential buildings in [[Damascus]], [[Syria]]. The [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] announces that a number of its militants are among the fatalities. [https://english.almayadeen.net/news/politics/israeli-aggression-on-syria-s-mazzeh--qudsaya-kills-15--inju (Al Mayadeen)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/14/at-least-15-people-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-syrias-damascus (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**In [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]], two [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] and three insurgents are killed during a raid in [[Harnai District]]. Separately, two civilians are killed and three injured after an explosion in [[Ziarat District]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/asia/explosions-in-pakistans-balochistan-kill-seven-including-two-soldiers-18232255 (TRT World)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**A [[Pakistani Taliban]] commander accidentally detonates a car bomb at his house in [[Mir Ali, Pakistan|Mir Ali]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], Pakistan, killing himself and six other people. Fourteen others are also wounded. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-suicide-bomber-northwest-7c2b4b5eb70a2f284ef9d10c97bad2d8 (AP)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**[[Doctors Without Borders]] reports that at least two patients are dead after [[Haitian National Police|police officers]] and [[Gang war in Haiti|vigilantes]] attacked [[ambulance]]s in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.semafor.com/article/11/14/2024/ambulance-patients-killed-in-haiti-msf-says (Semafor)] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/13/americas/haiti-ambulance-attack-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[25th Annual Latin Grammy Awards]]
**[[People of the Dominican Republic|Dominican]] singer [[Juan Luis Guerra]] is the biggest winner with four awards. [https://www.billboard.com/music/awards/2024-latin-grammys-winners-list-1235828734/ (''Billboard'')]
*It is announced that the [[Kingda Ka]] [[roller coaster]], the world's [[List of roller coaster rankings|tallest roller coaster]], will be retired at the [[Six Flags Great Adventure]] [[amusement park]] in [[New Jersey]], [[United States]]. '''Business and economy'''
*''[[The Onion]]'', an American media company known for its [[News satire|satirical news content]], acquires ''[[InfoWars]]'', with the intent of rebranding the site into a parody of itself. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/11/14/business/media/alex-jones-infowars-the-onion.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**More than 24,000 people are evacuated as [[Typhoon Usagi (2024)|Typhoon Usagi]] makes landfall in [[Baggao]], [[Cagayan]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/mass-evacuations-as-typhoon-usagi-hits-philippines/a-70775901 (DW)]

'''Health and environment'''
*A study published in the [[medical journal]] ''[[The Lancet]]'' reports that the number of adults who have [[diabetes]] globally has increased from 200 million people in 1990 to around 800 million people in 2022. The study also reported that around 40% of adults with diabetes are not [[diabetes medication|receiving treatment]] for the disease. [https://www.dw.com/en/global-diabetes-rate-has-doubled-in-last-30-years-study/a-70774403 (DW)] [https://www.theguardian.com/society/2024/nov/13/diabetes-rates-increase-world-study (''The Guardian'')]
